title: Kinhold Update: Improved outpost combat
author: SweetKarmaz
selftext: Kinhold is being built with Claude Code. Updates included: A tower, attackers able to damage outpost walls and breach them, able to damage building walls, defenders not sallying out against overwhelming odds, archers staying or moving to elevated positions, general improvements to NPC bunching up, and then general battle AI.

comments.author: MrDankyStanky
comments.body: Looks like it could be pretty cool!

replies.author: SweetKarmaz
replies.body: Thanks! Its been a few months getting to this point (including all the rest thats already been done on this project, from a randomized voxel world with each new game, multiple biomes, a settlement system with villagers that work and multiply, etc). Hopefully a few more months and it will be releasable!
